description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the 'ReportGeneratorDao' component related to 'PimDefinedReport' functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup methods, multiple test cases for CRUD operations, and precondition data population.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportGeneratorDao's handling of PimDefinedReport related operations in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup to populate test fixtures before any tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment and initializes the ReportGeneratorDao instance.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving a list of PIM-defined reports returns expected results.

methods.name: testDeletePimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Checks that deleting specific reports yields the expected count.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportById
methods.description: Validates retrieving report details by ID.

methods.name: testSavePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests saving a new PIM-defined report with associated filters and display fields.

methods.name: testUpdatePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Verifies that updating an existing report works as expected.
